problem_type: Selected Run projected through legacy document plan ownership
symptom: Clicking a saved Run in creation displays the legacy plan or empty view.
direct_cause: Sidebar selected activeCreationRunId but workspace and editor only consumed storyboardDesignsByDocumentId.
class_root: Read and write targets were not bound to the same project, document, Run and revision.
affected_population: Document-admitted generation Runs and users switching among sibling Runs or documents
entry_points: Original StoryboardPlanEditor receives useStoryboardRunHost for exact Run save
internal_only_reason: This is an application-owned persistence and selection invariant, independent of framework behavior.
invariants: Run shots are authored only in generationPlan via production repository CAS
Unknown source documents are never guessed
Project/document/Run-bound input buffers survive view switches; content CAS conflicts retain local edits until explicit recovery.
Read projection ownership follows the current mounted consumer identity; late request settlement cannot change another project or conversation UI state.

door_reduction.why_not: Existing sidebar/editor and resident/data/panel consumers retain distinct UI responsibilities; project refresh and panel request lifecycle enforce ownership centrally for all of them.

generality_proof: Project/document filtering and keyed Run editor isolate sibling Runs and documents; CAS save includes original identity and never writes legacy design state.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve selection only within project and documented source
Read and CAS-write the captured Run identity
Only the mounted hook binds the read project; refresh and late list results cannot replace that owner.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Lists multiple Runs with recorded source only
Selected Run precedes legacy design and suppresses legacy auto-select

recurrence.reason: Every project can have multiple documents and every document sibling Runs.
same_class_scan: door-map setStoryboardPlan enumerated legacy editor, overrides, canvas tool, shot table and onboarding
Reviewed Sidebar and Workspace ownership and Run repository command CAS

2026-09-20 door-map refreshCreationRunPlans/readCreationRunSelection/useCreationRunPlans: Sidebar and hidden Run host share WorkbenchShell projectId; late saves and stale refresh callbacks converge on refresh admission.

prevention.invariant: Run host captures project/source/Run/content token and persists through the sole repository owner. The mounted list consumer alone binds its project; a refresh never changes that owner.
prevention.failure_mode: Wrong immutable source document token fails visibly; stale author content token fails without adopting refreshed content or writing legacy state. expectedRevision alone is not the author-content CAS, because unrelated runtime progress may advance it. Old-project refresh is ignored without changing the bound read owner.
prevention.strategy: Reuse StoryboardPlanEditor with captured Run host and original draft session; preserve dirty input across view switches and reject stale content writes. Separate hook binding from refresh admission and invalidate old list epochs on bind/release; late saves use the same guarded refresh boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed legacy fallthrough for selected Run and discard menu; original legacy designs retain their independent original editing without Run mirroring.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency change is needed for application identity and ownership.

migration: No rewriting or guessed migration. Legacy designs remain readable/editable through their existing owner; Run is never copied there.
residual_risks: Real Electron edit/save/reopen acceptance remains distinct from controlled repository and input-buffer tests.
